statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of transient loss of consciousness
The patient has brief neurological deficits suggestive of a transient cerebral ischemic attack
There is concern for a cardiogenic etiology
The service was ordered to evaluate for underlying arrhythmias that may be precipitating syncopal events and transient ischemic attacks
The diagnosis codes are R55 and G45.9
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization before services were rendered
